This regeneration anchors first_frame_pose_id to the SAME base pose as the reveal+click ('Acquire Cutin' cmpvpsons0016rhwrota1fytl), so dismiss f0 starts exactly at the wings-spread hero rest and the wings stay OPEN/SPREAD across all 25 frames. postprocess.tool: removeBg-ultra clean source -> per-cell alpha-bleed -> animevideo x2 (texture match to lunabi reveal) -> Reinhard color match to lunabi reveal body stats -> frame0-align to reveal bbox -> assemble 5x5/25 -> halo_strip safety pass

texture_match.why: same model as lunabi reveal (cutin_anim) so the dismiss carries the same texture character

color_match.method: Reinhard per-channel mean+std (std ratio clamped 0.7-1.4), excluding halo (min<150) from body stats

halo_strip.why: remove residual bright white-halo fringe (gold/purple preserved by the saturation guard)

sharpness_color_metric.note: Edge fringe near 0 on the hold frames; f8 (1.85) is the intentional violet moonlight-glow bloom and matches the reveal's own brightness level, not an edge halo. Whole-sheet edge alpha = 0. Gold ring preserved (fresh removeBg ultra, no tears).

qa.connection_check: NEW dismiss f0 silhouette matches reveal f0 (wings spread); wings stay spread f0→f8→f24; identity (dark-purple bat, gold ring, crescent moon, wings, fangs) preserved.

reimport_note: Loaded at runtime via ProjectResourceLoader.load_imported_texture (size_limit 3840 from the .import), so the imported .ctex must be regenerated.
